name: ops
summary: Traceable project and meeting action records with explicit ownership, status and human follow-up review.

rubric.text: Action records pass the local schema, identity, ownership and status checks, with observed results retained.
Person review checks coverage against the source meeting or project record and identifies missing or duplicated actions.
Person review confirms assignments and follow-up dates were agreed, or marks them proposed or unknown; completion requires evidence.

checks.note: Manual, advisory example only: bun templates/checks/ops.mjs <actions.json>. A schema pass does not prove meeting coverage or agreement.
